title: Prompt provenance & microcohort selection for quantization validation (per-domain micropacks)
creator: Marcus Chen
description: Goal: Produce deterministic, auditable per-domain micro-packs of production prompts (and associated responses) optimized for FP8/INT8 calibration and accuracy validation. These micro-packs will be the canonical input to our quantization pipeline and the validation harness used by model onboarding and runtime rollouts. Scope: provenance tagging, microcohort selection rules, stratification heuristics (length, token entropy, client/tenant, intent), data sanitization & privacy, deterministic seeding, and orchestration scripts to produce per-domain packs on demand. Excludes: retraining datasets or long-term archival storage policies.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A reproducible pipeline that emits per-domain micro-packs (configurable N_examples, seed) for FP8/INT8 calibration; 2) Each pack contains metadata: prompt_id, client_tier (anonymized), timestamp_window, policy_flags (PII_filtered, synthetic_aug), token_length_bucket; 3) Automated tests verifying stratification ratios (length/entropy/tenant) and recency weighting; 4) Benchmarks showing <=1.2% top-1 token accuracy degradation relative to float baseline for INT8 quantized model on representative domains; 5) Documentation and runbook for generating packs and interpreting results.
success_metrics: - Per-domain validation coverage: >= 90% of high-traffic intents represented in micro-packs; - Quantization regressions (token-level) within target budget (INT8: <=1.2% degrade, FP8: <=0.8%); - End-to-end reproducibility: pipeline seeds produce identical packs across runs; - Time-to-generate: micro-pack generation <= 20 minutes for domain with 100k historical prompts on our staging infra.
decisions: - Use a hybrid selection strategy: provenance-first (preserve original prompt pairs), then apply stratified sampling (length, entropy) with recency decay (lambda=0.8) to favor recent behavior. - Anonymization: client identifiers will be hashed with a salted HMAC; tenant-level holdouts preserved for per-tenant validation. - Synthetic augmentation (paraphrases, token-dropping) will be applied only for low-volume domains and flagged in metadata. - Default micro-pack size: 1,024 examples for initial rollout; parameterizable per domain.
blockers: - Waiting on legal to sign off on the recommended hashing/salting scheme for client IDs (security_review_required=false but legal sign-off required); - Need mapping table from telemetry schema to production prompt IDs (data infra task DA-1127).
